fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects unusual parent or children of the ImagingDevices.exe (Windows Contacts) process as seen being used with Bumblebee activity
fields.name: ImagingDevices Unusual Parent/Child Processes
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((src.process.image.path contains "\\WmiPrvSE.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\svchost.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\dllhost.exe") and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\ImagingDevices.exe") or src.process.image.path contains "\\ImagingDevices.exe"))
